name: RC-B10-0471/2025 – § 21 – Am 9
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on renewing the EU-Africa partnership: building common priorities ahead of the Angola Summit
part_text: 21.Stresses that African youth must be at the heart of a renewed EU-Africa partnership; stresses that the EU-AU partnership serves as an opportunity for African governments to provide possibilities, including job creation, for their citizens, and that the EU can assist and support such African-driven efforts; underlines that bringing young people from both continents closer together through greater mutual understanding and stronger bonds is essential for a lasting and equal partnership; calls for the strengthening of student and research exchange programmes; supports the increased participation of European students in exchange programmes with African universities; calls, moreover, for increased support for African universities, vocational institutes and youth-led initiatives to strengthen skills, innovation and exchange;
